text: Impossible. I watched you die three years ago.
So the failed doll still made the train.
The real Yuma Asakura died three years ago. You carry his memories, but you did not return from the place where he died.
If you truly have Yuma's memories, tell me. What did you say when we planned to escape?
Yuma left this for you. He said: if someone inherits my memories, do not ask him to become me. Let him choose who he will be.
The more you resemble Yuma, the more it will hurt when she dies. Kill Mizuki, and I will give you a human body.
Kill her. Before the clock reaches zero.
You are not Yuma. So I will not ask you to live in his place. Tomorrow, you can decide your own name.
Three years ago, I chose the kingdom over Yuma. I changed your memory, Mizuki. That sin is mine.
